_readme: STAR WARS: SQUADRONS — matches the game's default control scheme, so no
in-game rebinding is needed. This IS the standard base mapping, so the
layout inherits default and changes nothing but its labels.
Throttle -> left stick Y (up = forward), roll -> stick X, pitch -> stick
fwd/back, yaw -> twist. Trigger fires, thumb FIRE = right auxiliary,
pinkie = left auxiliary, C = cycle targets, B = countermeasures,
A = free look, D = select target ahead, I = boost, POV hat = power mgmt.
